title: yadakchi.review.requested.v1
description:
Something a human has to decide.

Producers: matcher, crawler, fitment, enricher, billing. Consumers: ops.
Kafka message key: request_uid — it must be set; compaction and partition ordering depend on it.
Cleanup: delete, retention 30 days.

This file validates a whole Kafka message body: the shared envelope from docs/specs/02-EVENT-CONTRACTS.md plus this topic's payload. Unknown fields are ignored, never rejected, at both levels — that is what lets a producer add an optional field without breaking a consumer.

event_id.description: UUIDv4, unique per emission. Two emissions of the same fact carry different event_ids; consumers deduplicate on the payload's natural identity, not on this.

event_type.description: The topic name without the 'yadakchi.' prefix and without the version suffix.

version.description: Envelope and payload version. A removed field, a renamed field or a changed type is a breaking change: publish to .v2 and run both until consumers migrate.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened, ISO-8601 UTC with Z. Consumers tolerate out-of-order delivery across partitions by comparing this, never by assuming global ordering.

producer.description: The service that emitted this message. Constrained to the producers declared for this topic in platform/kafka/topics.yml.

trace_id.description: Propagated across the whole chain for debugging. Minted by crawler on the listings.observed topic and carried through every derived event; a service starting a chain of its own (a human admin edit, a scheduled recomputation) mints a fresh one. Every service logs it.

payload.description: Five services produce to this topic; matcher owns the schema and every other producer carries a byte-identical consumed/ copy. evidence must be SELF-SUFFICIENT: ops renders the review screen from this event alone and must never query another service to do it — a review stays decidable when the rest of the system is down. This topic is not compacted, so payload is never null; there is no tombstone on a delete-retention topic.

request_uid.description: Identity of this review request. Also the Kafka key; ops deduplicates on it.

kind.description: What kind of decision is being asked for. Spec 02 documents merge_pair, split_product, adapter_broken, synonym_candidate and price_ambiguous; the field is an open string so a producer's own spec can name a further kind without a wire-format change.

priority.description: Higher is more urgent, traffic-derived where applicable. ops orders the queue by this and never FIFO — a reviewer working FIFO spends the day on products nobody looks at.

subject.description: The kind-specific identifiers this request is about: the offer_uids of a pair, a source_key, a candidate token and part type.

evidence.description: Everything a human needs to decide, inline. For a merge_pair that is both titles raw and normalized, brands, part numbers, part types, pack quantities, authenticity claims, both prices, the resulting price range, fitment sets, images, the model's reason_fa and the score with the features that drove it.
